notes.title: Main beta version Update #2
notes.notes:
We have been working hard and are ready to present you with another major update to the demo version of the game

What's new:

Long-eared companions added

Rage mode added

Locations redesigned

New enemy grenade behavior

Simplified boss fight

VFX update

New skill cards design

аnd many other minor changes!

In the next update (in about a week), we will show you a much more interesting boss fight and more destructibility in locations. Stay tuned

notes.title: Main demo version update
notes.notes:
Today we've released a major update to demo version. Here's the patchnote:

Significantly redesigned the locations

Added lots of new enemies, including Priests and flying beetles

Added a rage mode (builds up by killing enemies)

Updated the visuals for upgrades and many other in-game elements

The ability to carry two types of weapons

Added exploding barrels

And much more!

We hope you enjoy this update. Please share your thoughts so we know which direction to take the project in next!
